reason: 'Days in February in a leap year' is bare recall; replaced with a calendar reasoning problem that uses the same fact.

fields.text: In a leap year, March 1 falls on a Friday. On what day of the week did February 1 of that year fall?
fields.explanation: February has 29 days in a leap year, so February 1 is 29 days (4 weeks + 1 day) before March 1: one day before Friday is Thursday.
fields.steps:
1. A leap-year February has 29 days, so Feb 1 is 29 days before Mar 1.
2. 29 = 4 weeks + 1 day.
3. The 4 weeks don't change the weekday; go back 1 day from Friday.
4. February 1 is a Thursday.
fields.hint: How many days are in February in a leap year, and how many full weeks is that?
fields.whyA: Friday uses 28 days (a non-leap February), which is exactly 4 weeks.
fields.whyB: Wednesday counts back 30 days instead of 29.
fields.whyC: Saturday counts forward one day instead of back.
fields.explanationTl: 29 days ang February sa leap year, kaya ang Feb 1 ay 29 days (4 weeks + 1 day) bago ang March 1: isang araw bago ng Friday ay Thursday.
fields.stepsTl:
1. 29 days ang February sa leap year, kaya ang Feb 1 ay 29 days bago ang Mar 1.
2. 29 = 4 weeks + 1 day.
3. Walang epekto ang 4 weeks; umatras ng 1 day mula Friday.
4. Thursday ang February 1.
fields.hintTl: Ilang days ang February sa leap year, at ilang buong weeks 'yon?

fields.stepsTl:
